Tank versus damage

Attack is only half the story. A Neutral Pal with high defense and HP survives longer in tower fights, while a pure attacker clears open-world camps faster. For raids and tower bosses, mix one high-defense Neutral Pal into the party so the AI absorbs hits while your damage dealers work. Element matchups matter too — Neutral is strong against the elements it counters and weak against its own counters, so check the target before you commit a team.

Frequently asked questions

What is the strongest Neutral Pal?

Hartalis has the highest base attack among Neutral Pals at 130.

How many Neutral Pals are there?

41 Pals in the current data have the Neutral element.

Which Neutral Pal has the most defense?

Paladius leads with 145 base defense.

Is a monotype Neutral team viable?

Yes for most content, but a single element team gets punished by its counter. Bring one off-element Pal for tower fights.
